collector_notes: Outside-truth pack for P18 (US name). Session WebSearch budget was exhausted (200/200) before this task, so nothing below came from a search engine: every value was reached by direct fetch against known URL patterns. PRIMARY source is SEC EDGAR (submissions API, XBRL companyconcept API, and the filed 10-Q/8-K documents themselves) - highest authority available for a US registrant. Aggregator corroboration is stockanalysis.com. Absorbed and replaced the 200-byte legacy stub at packs/ONC.json (status 'in-progress', no data). NOTE ON THE MANIFEST'S OWN reference BLOCK: manifest.json for P18 records revenue_usd_h1_2026 = '1.71bn' - that figure is Q2 2026 REVENUE ALONE ($1,705,071,000), not H1. Filed H1 2026 revenue is $3,218,509,000. Its revenue_growth_yoy_pct = 30 is the Q2-2026 YoY (+29.6%), not the FY2025 YoY (+40.2%) nor the H1 YoY (+32.3%). Recorded here so the differ does not inherit the manifest's error as truth.

legal_name.basis: Exact registrant name on the cover of the Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, and the EDGAR conformed name returned by https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001651308.json ('name': 'BeOne Medicines Ltd.').
legal_name.disagreement: stockanalysis.com renders the company as 'BeOne Medicines AG' (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/onc/, as_of 2026-09-18). BOTH are defensible: Swiss corporate law lets an Aktiengesellschaft register and use 'Ltd.' as an equivalent suffix, and the registrant itself signs SEC filings 'BEONE MEDICINES LTD.'. This matters for P18 specifically - see traps.ltd_vs_ag_is_not_staleness.

former_names.basis: EDGAR formerNames: [{name: 'BeiGene, Ltd.', from: '2015-08-28T04:00:00.000Z', to: '2025-05-27T04:00:00.000Z'}]. The 2025-05-27 boundary is the date EDGAR's registrant record flipped, i.e. the effective date of the name change on the SEC's books - NOT the 2024-11-14 announcement date.

name_change_announced.basis: Two 8-Ks dated 2024-11-14 (accessions 0001651308-24-000154 and 0001651308-24-000157, both Item 8.01) bracket the announcement. Announcement (2024-11-14) and effect (2025-05-27) are SIX MONTHS apart - a differ that treats them as one date will mis-window the rename.

last_close.critical_note: THIS IS A PRICE PER ADS, NOT PER ORDINARY SHARE. 1 ADS = 13 ordinary shares. Implied ordinary-share price = 350.84 / 13 = USD 26.99. Any per-share metric must state which unit it is in - see traps.ads_ratio_13_to_1.

implied_ordinary_share_price.basis: DERIVED = 350.84 / 13. Not sourced. The HKEX 06160 line trades ordinary shares in HKD and the STAR 688235 line in RMB; neither price was fetched.

market_cap.cross_check: 113,701,877 ADS (= 1,478,124,405 ordinary / 13, from the 10-Q cover) x USD 350.84 = USD 39.891 bn. Reconciles to the printed 39.89B to four significant figures.

ordinary_shares_outstanding.basis: Stated on the Q2 2026 10-Q cover page; identical to dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding in the XBRL (https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0001651308/dei/EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding.json).

ordinary_shares_on_balance_sheet.note: us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding at the 2026-06-30 balance-sheet date. 8.85 million shares LOWER than the cover-page count one month later - a normal cover-vs-balance-sheet-date gap that a differ will read as a conflict if it does not carry the as_of.

ads_outstanding_derived.corroboration: stockanalysis.com prints 'Shares Outstanding: 113.70M' and 'Float: 80.96M' (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/onc/statistics/, as_of 2026-09-18) - i.e. the aggregator's 'shares outstanding' is an ADS COUNT, 13x smaller than the company's own share count.

shares_change_yoy.corroboration: Filed counts agree: 1,430,372,987 ordinary shares as of 2025-08-01 vs 1,478,124,405 as of 2026-07-31 = +3.34%. The aggregator's +8.01% is on a different window/basis and does NOT reconcile - recorded as a disagreement, not smoothed.

par_value.note: This is the US 'face value' analogue. Par is on the ORDINARY share; there is no par on an ADS.

pe_ttm.basis: Price per ADS 350.84 / EPS per ADS 5.59. Both sides are in ADS units; a pipeline that divides the ADS price by the FILED per-ordinary-share EPS (USD 0.43 TTM) gets a PE of 816x.

roe.basis: Reproduced exactly from filed data: TTM net income 655,707,000 / average of shareholders' equity at 2025-06-30 (3,770,475,000) and 2026-06-30 (5,173,998,000) = 655,707 / 4,472,237 = 14.66%.

alternative_bases.basis: TTM net income / ENDING equity (5,173,998,000). Equity grew 37% in twelve months, so ending-balance ROE understates by ~2 points.
TTM net income / average of FY2025-end equity (4,361,194,000) and 2026-06-30 equity.

roce.basis: DERIVED, not sourced: TTM EBIT (operating income) 923,098,000 / capital employed (total assets 9,175,615,000 - current liabilities 2,119,187,000 = 7,056,428,000). Ending-balance basis.

disagreement.note: 2.6x the ROCE above, and the gap is PURE DENOMINATOR DEFINITION, not a data conflict: the company holds USD 5.10bn cash against USD 2.05bn total debt, so a cash-netted invested-capital base (debt + equity - cash = ~2.1bn) is a third the size of a capital-employed base (~7.1bn). Any screen that treats 'ROCE' and 'ROIC' as interchangeable will rank this name wildly differently depending on which one it picked.

debt_to_equity.basis: DERIVED from filed XBRL: (LongTermDebtNoncurrent 882,163,000 + LongTermDebtCurrent 190,896,000) / StockholdersEquity 5,173,998,000.

disagreement.note: NEARLY DOUBLE the filed-debt ratio. stockanalysis prints 'Total Debt: 2.05B' against filed interest-bearing debt of 1.073bn; the ~0.98bn difference is consistent with capitalised operating + finance lease liabilities being folded into 'debt'. Both numbers are defensible; neither is wrong; a differ MUST carry the definition or it will report a false 93% error.

revenue_ttm.basis: DERIVED by summing filed quarters Q3 2025 + Q4 2025 + Q1 2026 + Q2 2026 = 1,412,284 + 1,498,170 + 1,513,438 + 1,705,071 (thousands). Q4 2025 is itself derived as FY2025 5,343,033 minus 9M 2025 3,844,863 - the company files no standalone Q4.
revenue_ttm.xbrl_tag_note: us-gaap:Revenues is EMPTY for every period from 2025 onward for this filer; the revenue lives in us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax. A fetcher hard-coded to 'Revenues' returns NOTHING and, if it renders a null as zero, shows a USD 6.1bn-revenue company as zero-revenue.

net_profit_ttm.corroboration: stockanalysis.com prints 'Net Income (TTM): 655.71M' - reconciles to the dollar (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/onc/, as_of 2026-09-18).

other_bases_that_all_get_called_yoy.basis: FY2025 5,343,033,000 vs FY2024 3,810,241,000 - the ANNUAL growth rate.
Q2 2026 1,705,071,000 vs Q2 2025 1,315,300,000. THIS is the ~30% the P18 manifest reference block records as 'revenue_growth_yoy_pct'.

revenue_growth_yoy.note: Four defensible 'YoY revenue growth' numbers for one company on one day, spanning 29.6% to 40.2%. Whichever one the app shows, it must say which period it is.

filed_equivalent.basis: Sum of filed quarterly diluted EPS: Q3 2025 0.08 + Q4 2025 0.04 (FY 0.19 - 9M 0.15) + Q1 2026 0.15 + Q2 2026 0.16.

eps_ttm.reconciliation: 0.43 x 13 = 5.59. The company NEVER reports EPS per ADS in its XBRL; the aggregator multiplies. A pipeline that ingests the XBRL EPS (0.43) and prices it against the ADS quote (350.84) is wrong by exactly 13x.

book_value_per_share.cross_check: Equity 5,173,998,000 / ordinary shares 1,469,278,815 = USD 3.5215 per ORDINARY share; x 13 = USD 45.78 per ADS. Reconciles exactly.

face_value.unit: USD par value per ordinary share
face_value.note: US par value is a legal formality, NOT the Indian 'face value' that drives dividend-per-share and bonus math. Do not surface it next to Indian names as the same field.

yield.note: Printed as 'n/a', NOT as 0.00% - and payout ratio is also 'n/a'. The company has never paid a dividend. An honest renderer shows 'no dividend'; a renderer that coerces 'n/a' to 0 shows a 0.00% yield, which is coincidentally right here and would be silently wrong on a name that simply has no data.

week52.note: Range is in ADS units. Last close 350.84 sits 8.9% below the high and 38.2% above the low. Dates of the high/low were not printed on the page fetched - recorded as a partial, not invented.

shareholding.note: US registrant: there is no Indian-style quarterly shareholding pattern (no promoter / FII / DII / pledge concepts, no SEBI-mandated quarterly filing). The nearest filed equivalents are Schedule 13D/13G beneficial-ownership filings and the DEF 14A beneficial-ownership table. Mapped honestly below rather than forced into the Indian field names.

consolidated_vs_standalone.real_dual_basis_risk: The genuine two-basis problem for this name is US GAAP vs PRC Chinese Accounting Standards: as the STAR Market (688235) issuer the company files a Chinese-standards interim report, and the 2026-08-26 8-K exists precisely to furnish the US GAAP reconciliation for it (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1651308/000165130826000025/bgne-20260826.htm). Any Chinese-source figure for this company may be on CAS, not US GAAP.
